_comment: Rules of skill H. A rule applies only if VERIFIED-REOPENED; an engineering rule states that it rests on no external source. No published standard exists for analog-based peak-sales ranges. Grounding lane (7 November 2026): every enabled rule carries passage_ids; ANALOG-MIN-3 is an ENGINEERING RULE and is no longer graded VERIFIED-REOPENED; the Cha error band stays DISABLED.

rules.passage: Cha, Rifai and Sarraf, Nat Rev Drug Discov 2013, supplementary Box S1 (local text 7 Nov 2026): "Of the 260 drugs used in the analysis above, 54 'outliers' - drugs whose consensus forecasts were >160% higher than actual revenues - were excluded from subsequent analyses." Context only; sell-side consensus on marketed drugs.

The error results of Cha, Rifai and Sarraf 2013 are in the article body, which is behind a paywall and was not read; the supplement gives method and an outlier count only. No forecast-error band is applied to any range. Gap stated: the article body is behind a paywall; Kossmeier 2021 (open access, Austria only) is context, not a replacement band.
rules.disabled_message: [CHECK] no forecast-error band is applied; the primary results were not read

rules.passage: ENGINEERING RULE of this skill: fewer than three included analogs gives no range. Gap stated: no published source sets this number; practitioner guidance on analog selection (VP-H-030 to VP-H-032) names criteria and no count. It is a floor against a range drawn from one or two launches.

Kossmeier et al., Front Pharmacol 2021 (PMC8414520, open access): 102 drugs in Austrian reimbursement applications 2005 to 2014; median overestimation of actual sales by 33%; 55.9% of forecasts more than 100% too high or more than 50% too low; saturated markets median accuracy ratio 2.15 [1.63; 3.50]; accuracy ratio 1.18 in year 1 to 1.34 in year 3. SCOPE: one country; context only, no error band.
